our Free: no mint and no flavour at all. Best if you're sensitive to taste or dislike mint.

Yes. In simple terms:

Natural Mint: the easiest everyday option. Gentle mint, mild cooling, and good if you want something easy to like.

Intense Mint: the strongest mint feel. Best if you want that fresh, sharp, just-brushed feeling.

Flavour Free: no mint and no flavour at all. Best if you're sensitive to taste or dislike mint.

Sacred Clove: warm, herbal, and very different from standard toothpaste. Best if you want a non-mint option with more character.

Enamel Shield+: the strongest formula for enamel support, with a mild mint taste. Great if enamel care is your main priority.

If you want the safest first pick, go with Natural Mint.

Keep it simple: put a pea-sized amount onto the toothbrush, brush gently for at least two minutes, then spit and do not rinse. Use it morning and evening, and hold the brush at a 45° angle to the gum line with gentle circular motions.

Natural Mint is a very easy first one to start with.
